name: trustloopguard
description: Workspace root for the TrustLoopGuard JS/TS layer. Rust workspace lives in crates/ and is unaffected.

scripts.dev:doppler: cd apps/web && doppler run -- pnpm dev
scripts.build:doppler: cd apps/web && doppler run -- pnpm build
scripts.server:doppler: cd crates/tl-server && doppler run -- cargo run -p tl-server
